Title: Azure Resource Mover is now in public preview

Body.Content:
Azure Resource Mover, in public preview, is a new service offering that helps customers move multiple Azure resources between regions to help take advantage of the most relevant datacenter regions and meet evolving data residency needs. By providing a single plane of glass to manage migration, it streamlines the process—accelerating planning, preparation, and execution while reducing complexity. 

Learn more.
